column1: # comment: Bridge2AI-Voice confounders/ columns that report a *diagnosis* rather than a sign or symptom, mapped to MONDO. Added on clinical review (2026-08-24) - a disease column cannot exactly or hierarchically match a phenotype term, so these belong in a disease ontology; the columns' HPO rows stay in b2ai-voice-signs-symptoms.sssom.tsv, weakened to relatedMatch where the HPO term is a manifestation of the disease rather than the disease itself. SSSOM object_source is a mapping-set-level slot, which is why this is a separate set rather than MONDO rows in the HPO file. Seven diagnosis-kind columns are deliberately absent because MONDO has no term for them - chronic_cough_med_hist_throat, glottic_insufficiency_med_hist_throat, laryngospasm_irritable_larynx, lesions_vocal_cord, muscle_tension_dysphonia, swallowing_disorder, vocal_cord_dysfunction - which is the voice/laryngology core of this dataset; those stay HPO-only. Every object_id verified against the pinned MONDO release with oaklib. See docs/mapping-conventions.md.
